jobs.label: Project record and evidence handoff
jobs.description: Carry one project record, its geography, linked evidence, review state, and exact files into a retained evidence package.

jobs.label: Land-use plan
jobs.description: Author, review, adopt, publish, and retain a statutory land-use plan under the applicable jurisdiction bundle.

jobs.label: Safety analysis
jobs.description: Acquire observed crash records for a project area, disclose source coverage, and retain the safety evidence.

jobs.label: Grants and reimbursement
jobs.description: Find applicable programs, preserve source limits, and carry an award through delivery and reimbursement records.

jobs.label: Model validation evidence
jobs.description: Open a genuine baseline, inspect separate AequilibraE and ActivitySim assessments, and download exact scientific evidence.

claims.applicability: A configured California general-plan descriptor supplies cited statewide requirements and process steps.

authorities.label: California Government Code, Article 5: Authority for and Scope of General Plans
California Government Code, Article 6: Preparation, Adoption, and Amendment
California Government Code, Article 8: Specific Plans

limitations: The descriptor is scoped, does not determine legal sufficiency, and does not replace counsel or qualified planning review.
Since October 7, 2026, creation, content, process, freeze and adoption select rules by plan kind, so a specific plan uses its own reviewed checklist.

The October 7 source review covers selected specific-plan provisions only. Earlier descriptor review dates remain unchanged; inherited duties, local overlays and complete legal applicability need further review.
Frozen versions preserve their retained rules. An earlier working draft keeps its saved checklist until staff reconcile it, which adds missing current sections and keeps existing content.

claims.applicability: FARS supplies Wyoming fatal crash records for 2010 through 2024 from NHTSA's National file, and a Safety acquisition stores them.
limitations: FARS is fatal-only. It cannot support an all-severity or serious-injury claim.
OpenPlan reads no Wyoming crash source with injury severity. The November 1, 2026 state source review rated Wyoming not usable: Only yearly totals are public.

claims.applicability: No Wyoming program bundle or reimbursement profile is registered.
limitations: Federal program descriptors match any U.S. workspace, but they are not enough to claim program eligibility or reimbursement procedure coverage in Wyoming.

claims.applicability: The v0.41 comparable-observation development registry has no Wyoming geography.
limitations: No Wyoming use-specific model validation assessment is available.
